eyebrows_furrowed.description: Furrowed eyebrows for WH-questions (where, when, who, why)
eyebrows_furrowed.citation: Zeshan (2004) Hand shape and Non-manuals in ISL Syntax

eyebrows_raised.description: Raised eyebrows for Topic marking and Yes/No questions
eyebrows_raised.citation: Vasishta et al. (1985) An Introduction to ISL

head_nod_slight.description: Slight forward head nod for affirmative declarative statements

head_shake_negation.description: Side-to-side headshake co-occurring with negative signs/predicates
head_shake_negation.citation: Zeshan (2004) Negation in Indian Sign Language

head_tilt.description: Head tilt indicating inquiry or spatial referent orientation

eyes_wide_expressive.description: Wide open eyes for emergency or high urgency signals

squint_intense.description: Squinting for intense focus or symptom severity description

neutral_facial.description: Neutral facial posture for baseline declarative turns

mouth_open_ah.description: Open mouth 'ah' shape for intensity or spatial scope

mouth_mouthing_gloss.description: Silent English word mouthing for technical/medical terms

body_lean_forward.description: Forward upper body lean for question engagement

body_lean_back.description: Backward body lean for contrastive topic or hesitation

q_marker_yn.description: Question marker for polar confirmation questions (Yes/No)

neg_marker_headshake.description: Explicit negation marker combining headshake and NO gloss

neg_marker_absence.description: Absence negation marker for non-existent symptom/item
